exceptions.statement: A command hook that exceeds its timeout fails open. The PreToolUse timeout is 15s in both managed-settings.json files. A sentinel that hangs is a sentinel that is not consulted.
exceptions.evidence: Claude Code hook semantics; managed-settings.json timeout 15

exceptions.statement: LEDGER_PRINCIPAL is whatever docker run -e says it is. Nothing signs it and nothing can tell a true principal from a claimed one. It is not a signature; it is a place to be caught lying.
exceptions.evidence: entrypoint.ps1 principal section; exit 12 if unset

exceptions.statement: The developer image denies nothing: permissions.deny is empty and the sentinel runs -Mode Observe. This is deliberate, because permissions.deny beats any hook decision, so an Observe image that denied would make the mode pointless. Receipts are still written on every call.
exceptions.evidence: images/developer/managed-settings.json; tests/Settings.Tests.ps1:106 asserts deny count is zero, with that reason

exceptions.statement: Hook behaviour under headless -p with allowedTools set to a wildcard has not been tested here and is not asserted by any test in this repo.
exceptions.evidence: no test in tests/ exercises headless mode

exceptions.statement: A hook permissionDecision is ignored when the tool sits in permissions.allow (claude-code#18312). Designed around rather than fixed: permissions.allow is empty in both images and entrypoint.ps1 exits 11 if a gated tool ever appears there.
